views.text: In January 2023, Equity Mates recounted Chipotle’s origin story and said the first store sold over a thousand burritos a day after planning for 107, highlighting strong early product-market fit and customer demand.

views.text: In May 2025, Equity Mates contrasted Chipotle’s company-owned model with GYG’s franchise model and said Chipotle delivered a 26% operating margin versus 16% for GYG, attributing stronger profitability to greater control over quality and operations.
